CustomField.label: RLM Asset
CustomField.description: Asset-Based Ordering shipment-gated billing. Direct link from a serialized unit to the shipped Asset. Used instead of the standard SerializedProduct.AssetId because a managed platform automation on AssetId references Asset.ProductItemId (absent in this edition) and fails; RLM_ShipmentFulfillmentService.confirmShipment stamps this custom lookup so the serial is visible on the asset and the console can count serialized units.
